description: Samoca于1958年推出的旁轴相机。配备Ezumar 1:3,5/50mm (model M-35) or Ezumar 1:2,8/50mm (model M-28)。快门速度leaf shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec.。使用35mm。

specs.快门: leaf shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec.
specs.取景器: optical finder with superimposed coupled rangefinder, bright frame with parallax correction marks
specs.英文简介: The Samoca 35 M is a rangefinder camera for 35mm film, made in Japan by Sanei Sangyō K.K.
